what_146J_got_wrong: the leak diagnosis (alphabetical tie-breaking / failed shuffle) was falsified: the shuffle equalised cells correctly (marginals 0.4846-0.5150, within-group spreads 0.0053-0.0083) and the model picks rank most, not conductor
actual_defect: every model emits a CONSTANT RANKING PER CELL, so the number of independent decisions is the cell count, not the test-set count; a binomial SE over 132,009 sets inflates precision by ~97x
scope: h4 only; sampled batches; action is feature selection over 4 invariants
